content.content: When invoked to reconcile, the deccy CLI shall report each registry record that still asserts a draft while jj has no workspace the record names, and shall change nothing.
content.rationale:
Every clause is a commitment a prerequisite already holds, stated as a requirement and nothing more. The trigger names the act vuopwuyo settles — reconciling is reading the registry against jj's workspaces and reporting the drift it finds — and is written as an invocation of that act, not as a command surface: no verb spelling, no flags, no output form. vuopwuyo leaves the verb name and the surface that carries the report to separate commitments, and this requirement leaves them there; naming the act in the trigger narrows a settled behaviour to the call that performs it. The subject is the deccy CLI for the same reason the report is a CLI read of deccy's own state rather than a probe of the graph: what is reported is the registry read against jj, both of which the CLI owns.

The reported set is "each registry record that still asserts a draft". owyntkvw fixes the record as a registry-local object with its own generated handle as key, one per draft and outside the node documents, so the things named are records the registry holds and enumerates — not nodes, not changes. vkkwusty fixes what "still asserts a draft" is: `open` is the record of a draft that has not landed and `landed` the record of one that has, so asserting a draft is the open state and the clause selects exactly the open records. A landed record whose workspace is gone is excluded, and must be: vuopwuyo states that absence under a landed record is the normal end of a draft, not drift, so reporting it would contradict the parent rather than elaborate it. The requirement says nothing about how records are stored, keyed or read beyond the registry holding them, which owyntkvw already fixes.

"while jj has no workspace the record names" is the join of three parents. owyntkvw fixes that the record names the workspace holding its draft, by name and path, as a reference rather than custody; xkolyytz fixes jj as the backend that versions the tree and holds workspaces, so whether the named workspace exists is jj's to answer; vuopwuyo fixes the absence of that workspace under an open record as the drift reconcile reports. The clause therefore compares the record's reference with jj's holdings and takes the records whose named workspace jj does not have. It fixes no existence policy, no repair direction and no reading order of its own.

"and shall change nothing" is vuopwuyo's non-repair: no node, no change, no marker, no rewrite, drop or forget, so a drifted record stays open and keeps naming the workspace it names. The requirement does not restate that as a retention rule of its own; retention at the landed end belongs to vkkwusty, and here the effect stated is that the report is the whole of it. Nothing is created, recorded or removed, and the invocation is not bracketed or undone.

What is deliberately unstated: the verb spelling, flags, output format and exit status (vuopwuyo leaves the surface elsewhere); what an operator does with the report; whether the report is streamed, sorted or counted; and any repair, cleanup or reconciliation of the registry against jj. This node settles one thing — that reconciling reports the open records whose named workspace jj lacks, and changes nothing — and leaves the surface that will carry the report to the commitment that owns it.
